subtitle: Spicy shrimp soup
verso: Shrimp soup: for a hangover, the best excuse.
story: A brick-red shrimp soup from the Pacific coast, built on dried shrimp and the heads and shells of fresh ones, with guajillo, potatoes and carrots. Seafood restaurants bring it in a small cup before the meal, and it's what you want after a long night.

ingredients.title: The shrimp
items: 1 lb medium shrimp, shell on (heads on if you can get them)
2 oz dried shrimp (camarón seco), heads and legs pulled off

steps: Peel the fresh shrimp and refrigerate them. Put the shells and heads in a pot with the dried shrimp and [[8 cups]] water. Simmer 20 minutes and strain. This is the broth.
Meanwhile, stem and seed the chiles, toast them a few seconds and soak 10 minutes. Blend with the tomatoes, onion, garlic and [[1 cup]] of the broth, and strain.
Heat the oil in the pot and fry the chile purée 5 minutes, until it darkens.
Add the broth, oregano, potatoes and carrots. Simmer 15 minutes, until tender, adding the chayote for the last 8.
Add the peeled shrimp and cook 2–3 minutes, just until pink. Season with salt.
Serve with onion, cilantro, lime and tostadas.

pressureCooker.time: 5 min high pressure + 10 min natural release (broth)
steps: Peel the shrimp and refrigerate them. Put the shells, heads, dried shrimp and [[8 cups]] water in the pot. High pressure 5 minutes, natural release 10. Strain and keep the broth.
Make and fry the chile purée on Sauté as in steps 2–3.
Add the broth, oregano, potatoes and carrots. High pressure 3 minutes, quick release.
On Sauté, add the shrimp and cook 2–3 minutes, just until pink. Season.
pressureCooker.note: Never pressure-cook the shrimp themselves; they turn rubbery.

tips: Dried shrimp are salty. Taste before adding any salt.
The heads hold most of the flavor. Ask the fish counter for head-on shrimp.

variations.name: Caldo Siete Mares
variations.subtitle: Seven-seas seafood soup
variations.note: The big soup of the seafood restaurant: the same red chile base loaded with fish, shrimp, octopus, crab and clams.

items: The broth, chile base and vegetables from the base
½ lb firm white fish, in chunks

steps: Make the broth, chile base and vegetables as in the base, steps 1–4.
Add the crab and clams and cook 4 minutes, until the clams open. Throw out any that don't.
Add the fish and octopus for 3 minutes, then the shrimp for 2.
Serve in big bowls with onion, cilantro, lime and tostadas.
